description: This Java test class `LoanProductWithChargeOffBehaviourTest` performs integration tests related to loan product charge-off behavior in the Apache Fineract system. It sets up loan scenarios, modifies loan product properties, and verifies that the charge-off behavior remains consistent in loan details despite updates to the product.

classes.name: LoanProductWithChargeOffBehaviourTest
classes.description: An integration test class for verifying the behavior of loan product charge-off settings in Fineract. It includes setup methods to create clients and loans, and tests to ensure that changes to loan product charge-off behavior do not affect existing loans.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up a client, loan product, and loan with specific parameters before each test execution.

methods.name: testSavedToLoanNotChangingWithProduct
methods.description: Verifies that the loan’s charge-off behavior remains unchanged after updating the loan product’s charge-off setting.
